usedFor: CalendarHero tracks meeting requests and contacts, and Algodocs stores a file when “Meeting Request Becomes Event” runs “Upload Document”.

bestTemplate.name: “Meeting Request Becomes Event” in CalendarHero, then “Upload Document” in Algodocs
bestTemplate.why: A confirmed meeting can file its paperwork in Algodocs without anyone uploading it by hand.

watchOut: “Upload Document” takes a file by URL or Base64, so the trigger must supply one of the two.
